rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a generous disposition or willingness to give, especially in formal or written contexts.

example.english: His generosity over the years is admirable.
example.traditional: 佢多年來捐款捐物，慷慨令人敬佩。
example.jyutping: keoi5 do1 nin4 loi4 gyun1 fun2 gyun1 mat6 hong2 koi3 ling6 jan4 ging3 pui3

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on a charitable, kind-hearted motive rather than generosity as a general trait.

example.english: They always help neighbours in need out of generosity.
example.traditional: 見到街坊有困難，佢總係出於善心幫手。
example.jyutping: gin3 dou2 gaai1 fong1 jau5 wan3 naan4 keoi5 zung2 hai6 ceot1 jyu1 sin6 sam1 bong1 sau2

rows.note: Use this for a particular generous or charitable act rather than for the person’s general disposition.

example.english: His donation to rebuild the school was a real act of generosity.
example.traditional: 佢捐錢重建學校，真係一樁善舉。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gyun1 cin2 cung4 gin3 hok6 haau6 zan1 hai6 jat1 zong1 sin6 geoi2
